errors.ai_service_unavailable: Voice and smart search need an OpenAI provider (Settings → AI providers).

fs_write.consequences: The file is created, or its current content is replaced.

fs_append.consequences: Text is added to the end of the file.

fs_move.consequences: If the destination exists and replacing is allowed, its old content is lost.

fs_delete.consequences: The file (or folder) is deleted permanently.

terminal_run.consequences: The command may create, change or delete files in the task folder (sandbox, no network).

github_create_branch.consequences: A new branch appears in the repository. Nothing else changes.

github_write_file.consequences: A commit is pushed to this branch (visible to everyone with access).

github_create_pull_request.consequences: A pull request is published under your account; people watching the repository are notified.

memory_save.consequences: The note is added to the agent's memory and used in its future tasks.

browser_screenshot.consequences: The site is loaded from the internet (it may run its scripts) in an isolated browser; a screenshot is saved in the workspace.

reasons.override: You asked to approve every use of this tool.
reasons.write: Changes need approval at this agent's autonomy level.

approvals.noneHint: When an agent wants to do something important (delete a file, open a pull request), the request appears here and you get a notification.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Everything agents can do. A tool switched off here is off for everyone; a tool switched on works only for agents you allowed it to. Actions marked “change” and “important” may need your approval.
